_comment: A class is a set of MULTIPLIERS over the global tuning keys, not a stat
block of its own. Giving each class absolute values would take the DBG
panel from 63 sliders to ~190 and end the on-device tuning workflow that
ADR-0004 exists to protect: you cannot drag 'damage' and feel the result
when there are three of them. Every slider still moves the whole game, and
a class says only how it differs from that. See ADR-0028.
'pellets' and 'spread_deg' are counts, not multipliers. The fan is
DETERMINISTIC - fixed angles across the arc, never random. Random spread on
a fast flat bullet is exactly the 'cant be expected' that got the bow
deleted (ADR-0022), and a fixed fan is both legible and repeatable.
EVERY NUMBER BELOW WAS SET BY MEASUREMENT, not by argument. The sweep is
`tools/measure_matches.gd -- 20 match_target_kills=999`, which plays every
class against every class with all six slots bot-driven and reports the
kill share. The Skirmisher started at 30-33% of the kills against a Ranger
team - a class that did not work - and reached parity through four measured
corrections, in this order:
spread_deg 11 -> 46   at 11 degrees the outer pellets stayed inside a
29 px cat all the way to maximum range, so the
spread was decoration and the class was a weak
Ranger. 46 puts the whole fan on target inside
~74 px and drops to the centre pellet beyond it.
fire_interval -> 0.8  rapid, as the class was always described.
move 1.18             it has to be able to close.
health 1.55           the one that actually worked. Crossing 107 px of
open ground to reach its own effective range costs
0.6 s under 222 DPS - two thirds of a standard
health bar spent before it can shoot back.
That pass ended at cross match-ups of 48% and 50% against mirror
baselines of 47% and 53% - within noise of even in both directions.
The lobber then re-opened all of it; see below.

'label' is the Hebrew name shown on the picker. The game had no text at all until the first APK playtest came back with 'there is no class selection, or am I missing something? all the icons look identical' - the two classes differed only by a small gun silhouette, which reads as decoration at phone size. The icons still have to carry the meaning for a five-year-old who cannot read (ADR-0013); the name is for everyone else.
THE LOBBER (M4.1) made this a three-way problem, and five sweeps of 20
seeded match-ups each were needed to settle it. What came out is a
TRIANGLE rather than a ranking, which is the shape worth having:
lobber     beats ranger      (+9 / -10 against their own mirrors)
skirmisher beats lobber      (+9 / -10)
ranger     even with skirmisher (+3 / +1)
Net standing -7 / +10 / -1, down from -13 / +21 / -3 before the last pass.
No class is dominant and every match-up sits inside 59/41, which is normal
for a game with counterplay rather than a flaw.
Two corrections in that run are worth keeping, because both were the same
mistake in different places - a number that had outlived its reason:
The skirmisher stayed strongest through two trims (damage, health). What
finally worked was charging it in SUSTAIN rather than burst: reload 1.45,
so two shells then a 1.3 s refill. Its close-range lethality is the thing
that was asked for, so that is the one part that should not pay.
The lobber opened beating the ranger by +13. Splash plus ignoring cover
is already a great deal of value; 0.85 damage on top of it was paying
twice. Now 0.7.
